docs.text:
Manmatha Nath Dutt’s English prose translation of the Sundara Kāṇḍa of Vālmīki’s Rāmāyaṇa, Hanumān’s leap to Laṅkā and his meeting with Sītā (Calcutta, 1892). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by Google from a copy in Harvard University; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Ramayana · Vālmīki. [from old catalog], Dutt, Manmatha Nath · 1891, 239 scanned pages. Published 1892; Manmatha Nath Dutt died 1912; the epic is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
